sloka: जातरूपम् इति ख्यातम् तदा प्रभृति राघव ।सुवर्णम् पुरुषव्याघ्र हुताशन सम प्रभम् ।तृण वृक्ष लता गुल्मम् सर्वम् भवति कांचनम् ॥१-३७-२२॥
transliteration: jātarūpam iti khyātam tadā prabhṛti rāghava ।suvarṇam puruṣavyāghra hutāśana sama prabham ।tṛṇa vṛkṣa latā gulmam sarvam bhavati kāṁcanam ॥1-37-22॥

translations.english: O tiger among men, O scion of the Raghus Then onwards gold which is effulgent like fire, became wellknown as Jatarupa (pure form). The grass, shrubs, creepers and trees of that forest looked golden.
